data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'loros', meaning 'light' or 'shining one'. In Greek mythology, Lorri was an epithet for the goddess Aphrodite, representing beauty and radiance. In Christian tradition, the name Lorri is associated with the radiant light of the divine. The name Lorri carries the meaning “Light, shining one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lorri usually hope their child will grow to embody light, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
